errors.problem: The bounds are not paired with their factors. In the displayed order (A, then the D factor, then the N^{-1} factor), they would read ||2^{2-2alpha^2}D||<7/8 and ||N^{-1}/2||<1. The paper has ||S'||<3/4, ||J'||=||N^{-1}/2||<7/8 and ||D'||<1 (lines 3621-3623). The contraction conclusion is unaffected.

errors.quote: moving an axis past a neighbour is a [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-chunk-interchange.md) of $\ell$- or $(\ell-1)$-bit fields, costing $O(Tp(1+\ell^\tau))$
errors.problem: The chunk-swap lemma (line 1631) interchanges two fields of equal width 2^u. In the paper, an ell-bit field and an (ell-1)-bit field are interchanged by splitting off the leading bit, swapping the equal-width pieces, and moving that bit with Lemma elementary-streams (lines 3879-3886). The page presents the unequal case as a single chunk interchange.
